name: SysWarden
description: Turn BunkerWeb's Layer 7 bans into kernel-level nftables drops with SysWarden, and deny SysWarden's blocklist at Layer 7.

USE_SYSWARDEN.help: Activate the SysWarden integration (ban push, blocklist download, telemetry).
USE_SYSWARDEN.label: Use SysWarden

SYSWARDEN_PEERS.help: SysWarden HA API endpoints, space-separated, as host or host:port (default port 62026). Bracket an IPv6 literal to give it a port: [2001:db8::1]:62026.
SYSWARDEN_PEERS.label: SysWarden peers

SYSWARDEN_API_TOKEN.help: Bearer token of the SysWarden HA API ([integrations.ha] token). Required: a peer with an empty token authenticates on the peer IP alone. Supports the SYSWARDEN_API_TOKEN_FILE Docker-secret convention.
SYSWARDEN_API_TOKEN.label: SysWarden API token

SYSWARDEN_CA_BUNDLE.help: Path to a mounted CA bundle used to verify the peer's certificate, for example /etc/syswarden/ha-ca.pem.
SYSWARDEN_CA_BUNDLE.label: SysWarden CA bundle

SYSWARDEN_SSL_FINGERPRINT.help: SHA-256 fingerprint of the peer's certificate to pin, when no CA bundle is available. One pin applies to every configured peer; use a CA bundle when peers have distinct certificates. Read it with: openssl x509 -in /var/lib/syswarden/ha/server.crt -noout -fingerprint -sha256
SYSWARDEN_SSL_FINGERPRINT.label: SysWarden certificate fingerprint (SHA-256)

SYSWARDEN_SSL_INSECURE.help: Talk to the peer without verifying its certificate. Explicit opt-out: without a CA bundle or a fingerprint, the jobs refuse to run instead of degrading silently.
SYSWARDEN_SSL_INSECURE.label: Skip SysWarden certificate verification

SYSWARDEN_TIMEOUT.help: Connect and read timeout in seconds for SysWarden HA API requests (1-30).
SYSWARDEN_TIMEOUT.label: SysWarden API timeout (s)

USE_SYSWARDEN_BAN_PUSH.help: Push BunkerWeb's active bans to the SysWarden blocklist, so the attacker is dropped in the kernel for every service on the host, containers included. The dialect is detected per peer: provenance-aware temporary bans on v4.03+, the historical payload on older ones.
USE_SYSWARDEN_BAN_PUSH.label: Push bans to SysWarden

SYSWARDEN_ENFORCEMENT.help: 'enforcing' pushes and removes bans; 'audit' logs every add and remove it would have made without sending anything. Start in audit.
SYSWARDEN_ENFORCEMENT.label: Ban push enforcement mode

SYSWARDEN_BAN_MAX_ITEMS.help: Maximum number of missing bans added to each peer per pass, 0 meaning no limit. A larger backlog drains deterministically over later passes; existing bans and removals are unaffected.
SYSWARDEN_BAN_MAX_ITEMS.label: Maximum bans pushed

SYSWARDEN_BAN_CHUNK_SIZE.help: Number of entries per POST/DELETE request to /ha/sync. A peer refuses an oversized batch outright (500 entries with ban provenance, 1024 without), so a higher value is lowered to whichever ceiling applies to that peer.
SYSWARDEN_BAN_CHUNK_SIZE.label: Ban push batch size

SYSWARDEN_BAN_SCOPE_FILTER.help: Space-separated list of services whose bans are propagated. Empty means every service. Global bans are always propagated: they are not tied to a service.
SYSWARDEN_BAN_SCOPE_FILTER.label: Services whose bans are pushed

SYSWARDEN_BAN_MIN_TTL.help: Skip bans with less than N seconds left, so rate-limit noise does not churn the nftables set. Permanent bans are never skipped.
SYSWARDEN_BAN_MIN_TTL.label: Minimum ban TTL to push (s)

SYSWARDEN_BAN_SOURCE.help: Required when ban push is enabled: a cluster-unique provenance tag written on every ban pushed to a peer that tracks provenance. Two BunkerWeb clusters pushing from the same allowed peer scope must never share it, or each would read the other's bans as its own.
SYSWARDEN_BAN_SOURCE.label: Ban provenance tag

USE_SYSWARDEN_BLOCKLIST.help: Download SysWarden's blocklist and deny those IPs at Layer 7 as well. Useful when BunkerWeb and SysWarden do not run on the same host.
USE_SYSWARDEN_BLOCKLIST.label: Use SysWarden blocklist

USE_SYSWARDEN_WHITELIST.help: Download SysWarden's whitelist and let it win over the blocklist, so an operator's explicit allow keeps working at Layer 7 too.
USE_SYSWARDEN_WHITELIST.label: Use SysWarden whitelist

SYSWARDEN_BLOCKLIST_INTERVAL.help: How often the blocklist and whitelist are downloaded.
SYSWARDEN_BLOCKLIST_INTERVAL.label: Blocklist download interval

SYSWARDEN_BLOCKLIST_EXCLUDE_OWN.help: Subtract the IPs this plugin pushed from the downloaded blocklist: BunkerWeb already bans them at Layer 7, denying them twice adds nothing.
SYSWARDEN_BLOCKLIST_EXCLUDE_OWN.label: Exclude our own pushed bans
